Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d

Class BluetoothStatus

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d.BluetoothStatus
public final class BluetoothStatus extends Object
Bluetooth adapter and device management for the control center, over bluetoothctl (BlueZ) and rfkill.

Mirrors the PrinterStatus seam shape: the parsing, formatting and command-building are pure and unit-tested (parseControllers(java.lang.String), parseDevices(java.lang.String), parsePowered(java.lang.String), parseRfkill(java.lang.String), powerCommand(boolean), connectCommand(java.lang.String), disconnectCommand(java.lang.String), label(org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d.BluetoothStatus.Controller)); the probes are thin wrappers over the tools. On a host without BlueZ, without an adapter, or with the radio rfkill-blocked, every probe degrades to an empty result / false rather than throwing, so the panel shows a "no adapter" state instead of failing.
